verdict.rationale: Homebrew shows some supply-chain protection: a newly introduced tap-trust feature lets users trust only specific fully qualified items from third-party taps, rather than whole repositories. That is a real but narrow protection against malicious package sources. There is no evidence of blocking install-time scripts or enforcing a minimum release age, and the tap-trust evidence is a single docs line plus a community reaction. Missing for 10: blocking lifecycle/install scripts, minimum release age or cooldown enforcement, in-depth docs on tap-trust policy configuration, independent hands-on corroboration.
